hard_stops: Do not implement or execute the process-and-signal matrix until the fresh authorization named by this freeze is recorded.
Do not call SIGKILL retained-state observation power-loss, crash consistency, physical durability or recovery evidence.
Do not add a cut inside pwrite, rename, fsync, F_FULLFSYNC or any other entered syscall.
Do not let the publisher classify its own retained state or pass expected bytes, semantics, classification or authority to the parent.
Do not release or close the selected-cut gate before the intentional SIGKILL.
Do not signal a process group, inferred PID, nonpositive PID, descendant or any process other than the exact successful spawn result.
Do not use Process.waitUntilExit, blocking waitpid, kill(pid,0), SIGSTOP, SIGTERM, a second SIGKILL or an unbounded wait.
Do not admit a path-only spawned process without the frozen suspended generation and mapped-main-image join.
Do not add process, signal, libproc or poll APIs to production, publisher or D3b reader sources; they belong only to the new XCTest harness.
Do not mutate, rename, clean, repair, retry or adopt the evidence namespace before classification and reader assertions complete.
Do not modify the committed D3b reader core, helper main or focused tests.
Do not migrate, rewrite, rename, clean, repair, delete or adopt any D2b/v2 namespace.
Do not add either helper to the application target or add Hypervisor.framework or an entitlement to either helper.
Do not infer producer identity, owner or lease continuity, authenticity, freshness, anti-replay, rollback resistance or authority from representation agreement.
Do not call the result H4 entry, Gate-E movement, candidate evaluation, scientific authority or an authority transition.
Do not edit, clean, stage or otherwise absorb unrelated dirty files or untracked artifacts.
